releaseNotes: 1.0.2 - Logs an error when the tank reaches the low-level threshold or Centri raises an alert; threshold changes apply immediately; timed polls wait for a free slot instead of drawing HTTP 429s from the 4-calls/day limit, and a refused call is not counted. 1.0.1 - No extra API call after a hub reboot. 1.0.0 - Initial public release.
